continuity: Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi have departed for China aboard a Chinese private jet to respond to the Sichuan catastrophe.
The International Gate Research Institute has found rapidly increasing mana density in many Gates, coinciding with a sharp rise in Gate accidents.
The Skeleton Warlord evolved for an unknown reason, and the newly appeared Lich may have undergone a similar increase in power; Taekyung expects the confrontation to be extremely difficult.
Taekyung spent one month away from the Murim and returned by Login; fewer than two shichen passed in the Murim during his absence.
Jeok Cheongang was asleep in the Murim Alliance pavilion when Taekyung returned.
Hyuk Mujin had been assigned guard duty but fell asleep while having an erotic dream; Taekyung woke him and mocked him before throwing the vase.
The Luoyang Strange Physician arrived at dawn to examine Jeok Cheongang and was struck by Taekyung's vase, suffering a concussion.
plot: Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi travel toward China aboard a private Boeing 747-8 VIP jet. Taekyung speaks fluent Chinese, drinks soju, warns Choi to assume the worst, and then sleeps through the flight while Choi explains that increasing mana density may be causing the recent surge in Gate accidents and that the Lich may have undergone the same unexplained evolution as the Skeleton Warlord. After a month away, Taekyung logs back into the Murim and awakens in a Murim Alliance pavilion beside the sleeping Jeok Cheongang. He wakes Hyuk Mujin from an embarrassing dream and throws a flower vase at him, but the door opens at that moment and the vase strikes the arriving Luoyang Strange Physician in the forehead, knocking him unconscious with a concussion.

Retain “hwabyeong” for the anger-and-vase pun, with an explanatory footnote.

active_continuity: Lee Jungryong has accepted China's request for Ares Guild participation in the Sichuan Catastrophe response.
China's contract requests thirty A-rank Hunters and two hundred B-rank Hunters as mercenaries.
China offers ten billion won for one week of participation and fifty trillion won for killing the Lich.
President Baek Hanseong is politically opposed to Ares Guild's dominance but cooperates with Lee Jungryong on the Chinese crisis.
Xiao Yang personally required Lee Jungryong, the Ares Guild, and Jin Taekyung to participate.
Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi have departed for China aboard a Chinese private jet.
Lee Jungryong intends to strengthen Go Jun so that Go Jun can defeat Jin Taekyung.
The International Gate Research Institute reports rapidly increasing mana density in many Gates, alongside a sharp rise in Gate accidents.
The Skeleton Warlord evolved unexpectedly, and the Lich may have experienced similar growth in power.
Jin Taekyung returned to the Murim after one month away; fewer than two shichen passed there during his absence.
Jeok Cheongang was asleep in the Murim Alliance pavilion when Taekyung returned.
Hyuk Mujin fell asleep during guard duty and was struck by Taekyung's thrown vase; the arriving Luoyang Strange Physician was also hit and concussed.
open_questions: What will Lee Jungryong do to strengthen Go Jun?
What will Jin Taekyung and the Peace Guild encounter inside the Sichuan catastrophe zone?
How powerful is the Lich, and can the combined Korean and Chinese forces contain it?
What is causing mana density to increase across many Gates?
